Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de piese pentru autovehicule
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Customs Advanced Specialist.
 If you think you'll like to manage the following responsibilities at higher standards:
Registers data related to intra-community acquisitions.
Prepares the monthly Intrastat declaration for acquisitions and deliveries.
Submits commercial documents to the Finance Department based on a delivery note (borderou).
Archives the documents they work with.
Carries out specific commercial and import-export activities in accordance with all procedures related to the role, legal requirements, and company objectives.
Translates import documents and prepares the required/mandatory documents for imports processed through customs offices other than the Brașov Customs Office.
Sends information to divisions when customs clearance is received for urgent goods and notifies the customs broker that the goods will be picked up via special transport.
Records imports in the tracking system.
Checks and submits the set of import documents to the Finance Department based on a delivery note (borderou).
 And If You Have/are
Knowledge of customs and trade compliance (especially EU regulations).
Attention to detail for accurate documentation and reporting.
Strong organizational skills for archiving and managing procurement records.
Communication skills for coordinating with internal departments and external brokers.
Problem-solving abilities for handling urgent shipments and special transport needs.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and ERP systems (e.g., SAP).
Language skills: English (written and spoken); other languages are a plus.
Bachelor’s degree in economics, International Trade, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Additional certifications in customs regulations, international commerce, or supply chain management are a plus.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in procurement, import/export operations, or logistics.
Experience working with Intrastat reporting, customs documentation, and international suppliers.
Familiarity with EU trade regulations and import procedures through various customs offices.
 Then we will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.
 Our international work environment can offer you challenging and rewarding opportunities. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
 More lives saved – more life lived!
